name: Silvana Marrone
headline: LAD Vice President | SaaS | Oracle Customer Success Services Sales
about:
Business-oriented senior executive with more than 20 years of proven experience in sales and pipeline management, services and P&L, business operations and delivery team management, occupying senior management positions at Oracle in Latam, being responsible for: learning sales management & delivery, services management, services strategy, successful P&L administration, budget planning, strategic alliances with partners and communities.

Solid experience developing and managing diverse and geographically dispersed organizations. Maintaining active network with main industry partners and customers in the Latin American Region. 

Exceptional communicator, motivator and strong negotiation skills, problem solving abilities and customer focus. Aggressively identify opportunities and niches for growth while improving operational excellence.

Focused in building winning teams and great capacity for execution and results oriented, stand out for its extensive experience in the planning, development and implementation of large deals.
